blog_images.rule: ogImage in MDX frontmatter MUST be a relative path starting with /. Never use absolute URLs (https://www.aureliusmedia.co/...) in ogImage frontmatter.

changes: Fixed PostHog analytics on production — Vercel env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST) had trailing newlines baked into the bundle, causing PostHog to POST events to https://us.i.posthog.com\n/i/v0/e/ (invalid URL). No events ever reached the ingestion endpoint, even though /array/.../config.js loaded successfully (assets are GET'd from a different subdomain).
PostHogProvider.tsx now defensively .trim() both NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST at runtime so trailing whitespace in env vars can no longer break ingestion.
Redeployed to production — confirmed /i/v0/e/ and /s/ (session recording) endpoints now return 200.
